summary.intent: Address all PR review comments on cipher-box PR #466 (automated reviewer feedback from CodeRabbit and Copilot), then debug a macOS CI failure in the cross-client sync e2e test.
summary.outcome: All 9 review threads resolved (8 with code fixes in commit d296afb, 1 dismissed as test-only script with no real secrets). The macOS CI failure—a race condition in Test 7 where FUSE's metadata publish could overwrite the SDK rename—was identified and fixed with a timing adjustment, then pushed.

repo: FUSE mount has a 1.5s debounce on metadata publishes; SDK rename must wait for the FUSE publish to complete before renaming or its changes get overwritten.
Folder lookup in inode.rs should prefer IPNS-based matching over name-only matching to avoid collisions when stable IDs are available (fallback to name only when no IPNS ID exists).
rename-folder.mjs is a test-only script using deterministic throwaway credentials (TEST_SECRET), so cryptographic key cleanup via try/finally is unnecessary.
RENAME_READY flag gates Test 7 (cross-client folder rename sync) in test-cross-client-sync.sh to allow incremental enablement.
SDK rename in tests uses 3 retries with 10s backoff.

code.finding: Swapped to IPNS-first matching with name-only fallback; avoids misidentifying folders with same name but different stable IDs.
Log statement downgraded to log::debug! and plaintext folder names removed to prevent info leakage in logs.
Same log::debug! downgrade and name removal as line 397.
Added ${MP:?} guard before rm -rf to prevent accidental deletion if MP is unset.
Test 7 race condition: FUSE folder creation triggers 1.5s debounce publish; SDK rename must wait for that publish to settle or FUSE's publish will overwrite the rename. Fixed with timing adjustment.

workflow: GitHub GraphQL thread IDs differ from REST API comment IDs; must use REST API IDs when replying to comments via gh api.
Fetching CI job logs requires listing jobs first to get the job ID, then fetching logs for that specific job.
Resolving review threads requires GraphQL (REST API does not support resolving threads directly).

friction: Network timeout when attempting to reply to multiple PR threads in parallel; had to fall back to sequential replies.
GraphQL comment IDs don't match REST API comment IDs, causing initial reply attempts to fail and requiring a separate REST lookup.
Fetching a specific PR review comment by URL required multiple gh api call attempts and filtering; no single clean lookup path.
open_items: Test 7 (cross-client folder rename sync) was only recently gated behind RENAME_READY flag—verify it passes reliably in CI after the timing fix before removing the flag.
The race condition between FUSE debounce publish and SDK rename may indicate a deeper sequencing issue worth hardening beyond just adjusting test timing.
